product.title: Taste of Miami Helicopter Tour
product.description: See Miami from the air on a short helicopter experience that highlights the coastline, cityscape, and surrounding waterways. This private flight format is tailored to your group and includes preflight coordination and pilot-led commentary during the route.
highlights: Private helicopter sightseeing format for your booked group
Aerial views of Miami neighborhoods, shoreline, and waterways
Pilot-guided route with scenic photo opportunities
Great fit for travelers looking for a time-efficient Miami overview

itineraryItems.title: Preflight arrival and briefing
itineraryItems.description: Arrive at the airport, check in with photo ID, and complete the flight safety briefing.

itineraryItems.title: Taste of Miami helicopter flight
itineraryItems.description: Fly above Miami for a scenic overview of key districts and coastal landmarks.

additionalInfo: A minimum of two people is required per booking
A valid passport or driver license is required

faqs.question: Where does this helicopter tour depart from?
faqs.answer: Flights depart from Miami Executive Airport at 14359 SW 127th St, Miami.

faqs.question: Is this a private flight or shared tour?
faqs.answer: This product is operated as a private activity for your booked group.

faqs.question: What identification is needed?
faqs.answer: Travelers should bring a valid photo ID, such as a passport or driver license.

faqs.question: What happens in poor weather?
faqs.answer: If weather conditions are not suitable, operators typically offer rescheduling or a full refund.
